hook: Me re-teeing for the ninth time while everyone waits.
setting: On a tee box with tee markers and the open fairway behind, both babies full-body on the grass.
action: Mulligan balances the ball on the tee and it rolls off; he sets it again and it tips off again as he speaks. He stares at it, hat sliding down.
sound: birdsong, a tiny ball tapping, an impatient sigh
judge: 'It's been nine' is a crisp, unexpected escalation on the ball-falling bit.
